source: Wowhead Forever NPC and object pages; listviews drops/skinning/pickpocketing/herbalism/mining. Row = [itemId,name,quality,count,outof,stack 'min-max']. chance = count/outof per kill or per node; avg qty = chance*(min+max)/2.
notes: Wowhead does not publish NPC coin drops or kills/nodes per hour; these must be learned in game.
Zone ids are Wowhead/AreaTable ids (4 Blasted Lands, 361 Felwood, 45 Arathi, 618 Winterspring, 490 Un'Goro, 47 Hinterlands, 46 Burning Steppes, 616 Mount Hyjal).
defaultRate is a coordinator assumption (not sourced): kill farms 120/h unless set, devilsaurs 30/h, gathering 60 nodes/h, Black Lotus 3 nodes/h.
Generic lower-level node farms have zone null: they apply in any zone and are matched by the looted GameObject id (or, as fallback, by the node's primary herb/ore in the loot window).
Generic node farms use defaultRate 60 nodes/h (coordinator assumption, not sourced).
